D2.source: Sountoulidis GSE215898; UCSC lung-dev author annotation
D2.scope: distal progenitor / spatially intermediate / proximal secretory developmental axis; no individual lineage tracing

V1.scope: enterocyte commitment toward a proximal endpoint; late progenitors are not asserted to be exclusively proximal

qc.primary: retain source-QC cells with positive integer-count total; retain only complete units at the unchanged floor
qc.depth_sensitivity: exact expected detection under hypergeometric downsampling; separately apply cell/unit floors

gene_universe: MGI classes with exactly one distinct mouse and one distinct human gene; symbols unique across classes; represented in all three assays; remove duplicated assay symbols

discovery.normalization: sum raw counts within unit/state; log2(CPM+1) using all deposited genes for library totals
discovery.ranking: descending minimum of the four median intermediate-minus-endpoint differences, then human symbol ascending
discovery.failure_rule: if fewer than 20 eligible genes, stop this specified single-module pilot; do not search alternate modules or run V1 programme scores

other_exclusions: human symbols beginning MT-, RPL or RPS, and XIST; exclusions do not make author labels independent of expression
score: mean within-cell percentile rank over the fixed cross-assay ortholog universe, with average ranks for ties; unit/state mean; equal unit weighting
transfer_rule: both endpoint contrasts must have a positive median, at least two-thirds positive units, and positive median after every single-unit omission; no confirmatory p-value for n=3

specificity.D1_stressed_control: paired intermediate-minus-activated-AT2 score; activated AT2 is a comparison, not guaranteed stress-only
specificity.control_excluded_module: remove genes in all frozen Hallmark controls; require at least 10 remaining genes, else specificity unresolved
specificity.gene_set_controls: 100 size-matched random modules, seed 0, sampled without replacement within discovery-mean-expression deciles; report descriptive percentile, not biological p-value
specificity.low_cycle: both E2F and G2M scores at or below their within-unit median among all three states; reapply floors
specificity.depth: 500-UMI expected-detection sensitivity with original module; reapply floors
specificity.interpretation: positive transfer with inconclusive controls is unresolved specificity; no universal or causal fate-control claim

adaptive_limits: Discovery-stop verdict applies to these settings, operational states, source-QC populations, ortholog map, ranking and thresholds. It cannot reject shared regulatory dynamics or all possible conserved programmes.
